description: Minimal office proving three engine pieces: (1) an action menu when a world object offers more than one action — a keycard on a desk, with an RFID cloner in hand, offers Clone it with the flipper or Take it; (2) clone in place — the clone opens the card's door and the card stays, so the owner notices nothing on return; (3) the consequence of taking the card — the owner returns, barks, and the card is cancelled (revoke_card), so the physical card and any clone of the same card_id stop opening doors.
test_objective: Verify the object action menu (clone vs take a world keycard), clone-in-place (card stays, owner notices nothing, the clone opens the door), the left-card consequence (owner returns to a missing card -> npc_left_item_gone -> onOwnerNoticesMissing revoke_card -> physical card and clone stop opening doors, owner barks, debrief capture), that a desk keycard with no cloner held picks up as before, and that the conversation clone (NPC rfidCard + # clone_keycard ink tag) still works.
